name: jauthia-crm
description: CRM omnicanal JAUTHIA: frontend Angular + backend Node/Express + PostgreSQL

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run db" "wait-on tcp:5433 && npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
